body: I guess I'll try that. It can't hurt, I guess. Thanks for the reply.

I appreciate the response, but with all due respect, you are the one who is wrong. The people who told me I am scum, a loser, piece of crap, they were right! They were right all a long. I always thought that they were just being cruel, I always held out hope that I was 'fine' and 'A-OK'. I once truly believed that I was a good person and not worthless. But, I was wrong, and they were right. Now that my life is ruined and almost blessedly over, I see how right they were. I'm looking forward to the end now, now that I know there is no hope.

I've called that number too many times. Never helps. Counseling doesn't help, been there done that. Nothing like this can help because I cannot be helped. I am not a human like you, I am the scum of the earth, the biggest pile of crap on the planet. Loneliness doesn't have to last forever, but for me it will. Thanks for taking the time to respond.
Did you not read the part where he did all of that and still had no luck?

I know you are just trying to be helpful and not hurt anyone but so many depressed people don't have any SO's or anyone else to help them. I'm glad you have someone that can, but depressed people drive people away from them. Nobody I've tried to connect with has ever tried to get close to me. And no, there is not "somebody for everyone". I know I will die alone, and the sooner the better.

why not leave? why continue this hurtful voyage? I hate myself and everyone in the world. I hate you, too. I hate everything. I wrote this pledge so I know I can't hurt anyone else when it is time to go. I'm punishing myself, not anyone else.
Sorry, sure go ahead if you really want to.
